playlistPickFailed: Could not select a video. Please try again.
playlistPendingSaveFailed: Pending items could not be saved and may be lost when you leave. Please retry.
playlistReselectNote: The file moved or its temporary cache was cleared. The playlist entry remains. Select the source again and confirm its framing.
playlistReadFailed: Could not read the video. Please try again.
playlistOriginalNote: Only the filename is available on the device. Choose the original video from your phone to adjust its framing. Saving records only the framing; converting and uploading adds a new device file and keeps the original.
playlistOriginalFailed: Could not read the original video. Please try again.
playlistRemovePendingNote: Only this playlist entry will be removed. Phone and device videos are retained.
playlistReadLocalFailed: Could not load the local playlist. Please retry.
playlistSaveLocalFailed: Could not save the local playlist. Please retry.
playlistAllAdded: All device videos are already in this draft.
playlistNotUploaded: This video is not on the device. Conversion and upload are required before playback.
playlistStartupNote: The device plays this playlist at startup.
playlistBluetoothNote: The device switches to this playlist when Bluetooth connects.
playlistPendingLoadFailed: Could not load pending items. Tap to retry.
playlistPending: Pending videos · Not uploaded to device
playlistPendingNote: Pending entries reference the original files. Conversion is not yet available. Keep source files in place after framing.
playlistSaveDevice: Save to device · Awaiting protocol support
playlistRecoveryNote: Resume the previous device video when supported. Awaiting protocol confirmation.
playlistReadDeviceFailed: Network connected · Could not read device
playlistReadNote: Read device content to verify the control connection.
playlistConnectNote: Connect to device Wi-Fi, then read its playlist.
playlistRemoveNote: Remove “{name}” from this playlist only. Phone and device files are retained.
